issue.title: test_action_reset_unconfigured_warns_and_skips fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Single-occurrence xdist-lane flake in the models panel edit/reset suite, same file and failure shape as sibling sase-x2.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once under the full parallel lane (just test-scoped escalated to the full suite because this turn's changes touched Justfile/pyproject.toml, invoked as .venv/bin/python -m pytest -n 7 --dist=worksteal -m 'not slow and not visual'): textual.widgets._option_list.OptionDoesNotExist: There is no option with an ID of 'medium', raised from tests/_models_panel_helpers.py:291 highlight_row -> panel._set_highlighted_index(option_list, option_list.get_option_index(row_id)) after ModelsPanelTestApp().run_test()/push_screen(panel)/pilot.pause(). Reran the same node in isolation 3/3 times immediately after and it passed each time (7.03s, 8.22s, 7.02s), consistent with option-list population/highlight timing racing under xdist contention rather than a deterministic defect. Discovered while running the mandatory just check/test-scoped gate during an unrelated rebase-conflict repair in sase_11 (Justfile/pyproject.toml/sase-core-revision.txt conflict); this turn's diff does not touch ModelsPanel, OptionList, or tests/_models_panel_helpers.py.
